title: HF3367 (2025-2026 Regular): 2024 changes to the crime of transferring a firearm to an ineligible person reenacted with certain amendments, and affirmative defense repealed.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2026-02-10; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2026/0/HF/3367/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2026-02-10. The text of Laws 2024, ch. 127, art. 36, sec. 3 is not in the file; only the reenactment reference. The repealed affirmative defense is printed in the appendix as old law.

operative_text:
Section 1 (uncoded reenactment): Laws 2024, chapter 127, article 36, section 3, is reenacted retroactively and without interruption from August 1, 2024.
Section 2 (repealer of Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 4): Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 624.7141, subdivision 4, is repealed.
